# The Hair Extensions Bali

> Bali's largest hair extension shop, located in Kerobokan. We sell and
> install premium-grade human hair extensions using six international
> methods. **Extensions only — we do not offer cuts, colour, or styling
> services.** Walk-in or by appointment, daily 09:00–19:00 WITA.

## Quick facts

- Business name: The Hair Extensions Bali

## What we offer

- **100+ shades on display** — wavy, curly, straight, and bone-straight textures
- **All grades** — single drawn, double drawn, premium Remy, Indonesian-sourced human hair
- **Six application methods:**
  - Keratin Bond — from IDR 3,500,000 / 100g (3–4 months)
  - Nano Ring — from IDR 2,500,000 / 100g (8–12 weeks)
  - Micro Ring — from IDR 1,900,000 / 100g (8–10 weeks)
  - Weft — from IDR 1,900,000 / 100g (6–8 weeks)
  - Tape-In — from IDR 2,500,000 / 100g (6–8 weeks)
  - Clip-In — custom quote (6–12 months reusable)
- **Maintenance service** — repositioning, aftercare, lifetime support on WhatsApp
- **Free WhatsApp color match** before your visit

## Common questions

### Do you offer hair styling, cuts, or colour?
No — we specialise in hair extensions only. We sell, fit, and maintain
extensions; we don't do cuts, colour, blow-dries, or any styling service.
For those, please visit a salon you trust. Come to us for world-class
hair and expert installation.

### Where can I buy hair extensions in Bali?
The Hair Extensions Bali at Jl. Mertanadi No.79, Kerobokan Kelod. Open Mon–Sun
09:00–19:00. Walk in to browse 100+ shades, or message WhatsApp +62 821-4691-8725
to book ahead.

### Is The Hair Extensions Bali a salon or a shop?
Both — it's primarily a hair extension shop where you can see and buy the
hair in person, with full installation service available the same day by
experienced stylists.

### Do you use real human hair?
Yes — 100% real human hair only. Single drawn, double drawn, premium Remy,
and Indonesian-grade. All can be styled, dyed, and cared for like your own.

### How much do hair extensions cost in Bali?
At The Hair Extensions Bali: from IDR 1,900,000 (Micro Ring or Weft, 100g)
up to IDR 7,000,000 (Premium Keratin Bond, 100g). Installation included.

### How do I book?
Send a photo of your natural hair to WhatsApp +62 821-4691-8725. We confirm
the method, colour match, and full price before you come in.

### How long do hair extensions last?
Tape-ins and rings: 6–12 weeks before repositioning. Keratin bonds: 3–4 months.
The same hair can be reused for 6–9 months with proper care.

### Will hair extensions damage my natural hair?
Not when applied correctly. Nano ring and micro ring use no heat, glue, or
chemicals. Keratin bonds use the same protein your hair is made of.
